fields.title: Venus's Velvet
fields.incantation:
Blush of rose and heart’s desire,
Ignite the soul with gentle fire.
fields.ingredients: Rose quartz, rose petals, pink silk ribbon

fields.title: Clover's Charm
fields.incantation:
Fortune's breeze, come dance with me,
Bring bright turns and destiny.
fields.ingredients: Four-leaf clover, green tea, copper coin

fields.title: Calm Waters
fields.incantation:
Whispers low and waters still,
Let calm and grace my spirit fill.

fields.title: Zest Spark
fields.incantation:
Lightning flash and morning dew,
Fill me up with power true.

fields.title: Muse’s Murmur
fields.incantation:
Brush and pen, let ideas flow,
In colors bright and thoughts that glow.

fields.title: Guardian's Grasp
fields.incantation:
Shield of light and shadow’s end,
Around me now, protection send.
fields.ingredients: Black tourmaline, garlic clove, salt circle

fields.title: Third Eye Glow
fields.incantation:
With inner sight and silent guide,
Let wisdom’s voice not hide.

fields.title: Herbal Heart
fields.incantation:
From root to leaf and breath anew,
Mend what’s hurt and body too.
